## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

List the commands or checks run and their results. State clearly if validation was not run.

## Accounting and security impact

- [ ] No accounting rules or persisted financial data are affected.
- [ ] If affected, the behavior, invariants and migration are documented.
- [ ] Business authorization and cross-business access were considered.
- [ ] No secrets or real financial data are included.

## Documentation

- [ ] Docs and roadmap status match the change.
